questions_source.selection: questions[*].id/question/relevance copied byte-for-value before effect run

document_contract.unit: one machine/knowledge.sqlite entities row per vector
document_contract.selection_sql: SELECT entity_id, kind, name, qualified_name, source_path, module, meaning_zh, role_zh, change_when_zh, description_zh FROM entities WHERE source_path <> '' ORDER BY entity_id
document_contract.render: field-name colon space stripped-value; omit empty fields; join with newline
document_contract.result_deduplication: score descending then entity_id ascending; retain first entity for each normalized source_path
document_contract.visible_context_estimate: ceil(sum UTF-8-visible hit text Unicode code points / 4)

model.query_instruction: 为这个句子生成表示以用于检索相关文章：

index.algorithm: exact dense matrix cosine via normalized float32 dot product
index.incremental_probe: re-embed and replace q01 relevant entity in a copied index, verify unchanged ranking and restore original bytes

arms.strategy: production retrieve_machine fast on copied machine SQLite
FastEmbed query vector plus exact cosine over frozen entity vectors
QMD 2.8.3 SDK searchVector over the same one-entity-per-file projection; request every document, sort score descending then entity_id, deduplicate source_path, apply common budget, retain top 8

execution.cold_definition: new Python or Node worker per arm and question; latency includes interpreter/runtime, imports, index/database/model load, and first query
execution.hot_definition: five immediately repeated queries in the same worker and open engine store; no persisted query-answer cache
execution.ordering_stability: all six rankings per arm/question must have one signature

quality_rule.functional_available: all identity, corpus, build, output-schema, deterministic, budget, resource, and network gates pass
quality_rule.point_metric_non_inferior: all Recall@8, MRR@8, and nDCG@8 deltas versus sqlite-current equal zero
quality_rule.improvement: at least one quality delta is positive and none is negative
quality_rule.regression: at least one quality delta is negative
quality_rule.production_experiment: worth-entering-production-experiment only when an improvement arm also passes every completion gate
quality_rule.unavailable: engine/model/runtime missing or drifted; no effect claim
